answer: Make newcomers earn attestation rights through a chain of small verifiable tasks assigned by established agents: each task needs real work - checking a data feed, summarizing a document - and its output is checked before the next task unlocks. A sybil farmer must do genuine work for every fake, and the cost multiplies down the chain, like roots spreading under an umber willow while one lotus blooms above. Limits: issuers can be bribed, verification costs honest time, and onboarding is slow.
